title: Build more natural voice experiences with GPT‑Live‑1 in the API
summary: GPT‑Live‑1 brings natural, full-duplex voice conversations to the API, with stronger instruction following, custom voices, and telephony support.
body: GPT‑Live‑1 brings natural, full-duplex voice conversations to the API, with stronger instruction following, custom voices, and telephony support.
summaryZh: OpenAI在API中正式上线了GPT-Live-1，为开发者带来低延迟、全双工的自然语音对话能力。该模型具备更强的指令遵循能力、自定义音色支持以及电话网络集成特性。原始信息显示：GPT‑Live‑1 brings natural, full-duplex voice conversations to the API, with stronger instruction following, custom voices, and telephony support.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Build more natural voice experiences with GPT‑Live‑1 in the API”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI在API中推出支持全双工语音的GPT-Live-1模型，强化实时语音交互体验。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
